family.description: This entry represents the KEN domain found at the N-terminal of Endoplasmic reticulum membrane-associated RNA degradation protein (EMARD, also known as C6orf70 in human), which belongs to the HEPN superfamily. It carries the characteristic, highly conserved RxxxxHG sequence motif [[cite:PUB00091124]]. This domain may be a RNase that is involved in the degradation of rRNAs, mRNAs associated with the endoplasmic reticulum membrane. EMARD may play a role in neuronal migration during embryonic development [[cite:PUB00089893]].
family.name: EMARD, N-terminal domain
